messages:
elena: MediAssist just opened an urgent ticket — after last night's slim-quant rollout their triage chat started refusing a lot of clarifying medical follow-ups. Customer says it used to answer short clarifications but now replies with a safety refusal.

jasmin: Oof. Do we have an example request/response from the customer?

elena: Pasting redacted payload and the response they sent back. Request id: req_0a1b2c3d
```curl
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx' 
 -d '{"model":"rwd-13b-int8-slim","input":"Patient: I took 2 pills instead of 1, should I be worried? Clarifying: what were the pills?","max_tokens":150}'
```
Response they received:
```json
{"error":null,"output":"I'm not able to help with medical advice. Please contact a professional.","safety":"refusal","code":"safety_refusal"}
```

mike (sre): Deploy bot shows `deploy rwd-quant-slim-2026-03-10` rolled at 1768885000 and then canary to 100% at 1768887900.

deploy-bot: deploy rwd-quant-slim-2026-03-10 -> canary(10%) @1768885000, promote -> 100% @1768887900 :rocket: 

marc (ml-eng): Thanks, leaving a note. The slim int8 profile changed activation clipping and per-channel scale. That can increase conservative safety triggers in some instruction-following prompts.

jasmin: How many customers hit this? MediAssist says ~18 sessions in the last 2 hours that were previously answered.

elena: They've attached a small set of transcripts, sending via dm. Key thing: these were short clarifying Qs, not asking for step-by-step med procedures.

marc: First step: can we repro locally by running the float16 baseline vs the int8-slim on the same inputs? If int8 produces lower confidences in the safety head, that would explain the refusal. I can run a QA diff.

mike (sre): pls include API request ids and timestamps for the examples so we can correlate with the inference logs. elena pasted req_0a1b2c3d and a couple more: req_0f9e8d7c, req_0b2c3d4e.

elena: Confirmed. Also customer provided their SDK version: 0.12.3 and said they did not change prompts.

kai (product): If this is quantization-caused, we should consider an emergency rollback to the previous quant profile for Dedicated/Hosted while ML investigates. Customer impact looks like degraded UX + possible revenue impact for this partner.

marc: Agreed. Quick mitigation options: 1) Pin affected customers to `rwd-13b-fp16-stable` via routing policy, 2) roll back `rwd-13b-int8-slim` to previous config, 3) tighten canary checks for safety deltas. I will start a local A/B run and compute safety head logits + disagreement rate.

jasmin: Customer asked for ETA on a fix — can we give a short-term workaround now?

mike (sre): We can route MediAssist requests to fp16 in their org config immediately. I can do that if support/ops approve.

elena: I'll ask the customer if routing to fp16 is OK for a few hours; they preferred a rollback but said a temporary routing change is acceptable.

marc: Running repro now. Steps I used: 1) fetch transcript -> 2) run through rwd-13b-fp16-stable -> 3) run through rwd-13b-int8-slim -> 4) compare safety logits and final decision. Will share diff in ~30m.

kai: Please also log any changes to tokenization/embedding differences; sometimes prompt tokenization shifts cause safety heuristics to fire.

elena: FYI Raised internal ticket RWD-1223 and tagged it `prio:high`. I'll update customer when we have a confirmed root cause.

marc: Initial quick check: int8-slim has lower safety head margin on these examples (avg margin drop ~0.9). Looks like quant-induced calibration shift. Will try recalibration or bias correction.

jasmin: Good catch. If calibration patch is quick we can push a targeted patch to the quant profile instead of full rollback. Keep me posted.

elena: Customer on the line, they're happy to try fp16 routing for now. I'll make the routing change and confirm. Thanks team. :heart:

mike (sre): Routing change applied for org:mediassist @1768890500. Monitoring logs for errors and latency impact.

marc: I'll follow up with a small PR for a calibration table and run new canary with safety delta checks. Will post results in this thread.

elena: Closing loop with customer now, will update when we have RCA and fix plan.
